generated.details: In the middle plane, right of the laptop, the plain charcoal craft cutting mat is a thin rectangular self-healing sheet lying flat, with faint cut traces but no numbers or lettering.
On this mat, unlabelled color swatches are separate stiff rectangular cards with matte cream, taupe and gray finish faces, slightly overlapped with visible thin edges.
Farther back on the right tabletop, the studio task lamp has a weighted round base, two jointed metal arms and a shallow shade aimed down at the swatches.
